reuse.why: Correctly extends the existing shouldFillCategory definition, but parses the tag with its own regex instead of the existing extractTagsFromText in shared/tags.ts, whose tag semantics (case sensitivity, ## escaping, # delimiters) differ.

duplication.why: The decision is single, but the same notes LEFT JOIN and group_notes column/type are pasted into six separate category queries in actions.ts.

placement.why: The rule belongs in fill-rules.ts, the declared single definition of which categories month-wide actions fill; tag parsing would belong in shared/tags.ts.

scope.why: Only the fill rule, its input type and the queries that feed it change.

maintainability.why: One rule location is good, but a private tag regex can drift from the app's tag semantics and six queries must stay in sync to supply group_notes.

bypasses_abstraction.where: isFixedGroup in server/budget/fill-rules.ts uses its own /#fixed/i regex instead of extractTagsFromText from shared/tags.ts.

disguised_duplication.where: isFixedGroup's regex re-expresses tag extraction from shared/tags.ts in a different form (case-insensitive, different delimiters).

one_place.where: isFixedGroup check added inside shouldFillCategory (server/budget/fill-rules.ts), which copyPreviousMonth, setZero, set3/6/12MonthAvg and setLastMonthSpending all call.
